clips.text: These are the terms. There are five, and they are short.
One. Use it for good. No reels that break the law, trick people, or bully anyone. And no pretending to be a real person or organisation.
Two. Your reels are yours. Pixel Reel does not claim them. But what is in them is down to you.
Three. Check what matters. A reel keeps things simple. For money, health, legal or safety matters, check the details with whoever sent you the original.
Four. No promises. Pixel Reel may be slow, or down. It keeps reels for thirty days at most, and may delete one early if it breaks these terms.
Five. Fair use. There is a limit on how many reels anyone can make in an hour. That way, it stays free for everyone.
